8 الاِعْتِقَامُ signifies The digging a well, and, when one has nearly reached the water, digging a small well, (S, K, TA,) in the middle of the former, (TA,) of sufficient dimensions for one's finding the flavour of the water; when, if it be sweet, the rest of it is dug, (S, K, TA,) and made wide; otherwise it is abandoned. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also
The entering into, or upon, an affair. (TA.) ―
-b3- And The overcoming [another] in a game of hazard; syn. القَمْرُ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
